gates.requirement: Invalid bounds, units, selection splits, seeds, estimators, multiplicity families, controls, or budgets fail with invalid_assessment_spec and no DSQAssessment.
Raw paired scores, un-oriented effects, orientation, oriented effects, seeds, estimator, and interval adjustment remain replayable.
Qualification requires a meaningful candidate and inclusive equivalence of every valid required node in a closed nonempty graph.
Candidate or proper-node rejection requires valid full-family uncertainty, controls, calibration, and dependencies.
Boundary crossing, missing evidence, missing closure, empty proper sets, budget exhaustion, calibration absence, failed controls, and uncertainty absence remain indeterminate.
Failure to reject is never substituted for interval containment within the equivalence region.
Nonmonotone and synergy annotations are preserved without an indivisibility inference.
Candidate IDs, assessment occurrence IDs, assessment semantic keys, and evidence-run identities remain separate.
Deterministic tolerance and seeded stochastic Bonferroni-normal protocols replay under exact family size and bounded evaluation counts.
Matching-pursuit and perceptual-coding baselines report whether their matched evidence satisfies the DSQ condition.
Dependency invalidation appends a canonical event, derives current invalidity, queues recomputation, and does not rewrite assessment bytes.
The Leonardo bird-call profile is explicitly design-only and contains no simulated or empirical outcome.
